subject.title: Add gated Claw hosted feed and lifecycle proof

question: Should ClawHub accept the proposed experimental `claw` package family and separate gated hosted-feed contract before its four dependent draft PRs are reviewed and landed?
rationale: The patch introduces a new registry family, public API/feed variant, lifecycle schema, and future compatibility commitment; technical tests cannot determine whether this product boundary should be accepted.

options.title: Sponsor the gated experiment
options.body: Approve the RFC-aligned experiment, review the stack in dependency order, and require hosted lifecycle proof before merging the feed slice.

options.title: Narrow the experiment
options.body: Keep the gate but reduce the initial contract to a smaller publication or discovery surface before accepting a hosted feed.

options.title: Defer the package family
options.body: Pause the stack until the RFC and long-term compatibility ownership are settled.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated experiment
recommendation.body: Approve the RFC-aligned experiment, review the stack in dependency order, and require hosted lifecycle proof before merging the feed slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged hosted-feed history makes this person the strongest available routing candidate for the feed-contract decision.
